LESSON: READING 7.4.1 INTENSIVE READING: SHORT STORY (CLASS READER)

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.4: Reading 7.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story (Class Reader)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 7.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short story (Class Reader), part of Strand 7 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How does one identify qualities of characters in a short story?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking: It is enhanced as the learner uses logical reasoning while discussing the actions of the characters.

• Creativity and imagination:It is enhanced as the learner shows the relationships between characters in the story.

Values:
